title: Dorfromantik: The Board Game
subtitle: Cooperative Pastoral Landscape Puzzle Campaign
tagline: Piece together a peaceful idyllic countryside and unlock secret boxes across an uplifting campaign.
loreSummary: Work together to lay hexagonal landscape tiles, matching sparkling rivers, golden wheat fields, and quaint cottages while fulfilling villagers' requests to unlock sealed achievement boxes.
keyFeatures: Cooperative tile-placement adaptation of the beloved tranquil video game
5 unlockable secret achievement boxes with new tiles, tasks, and scoring mechanics
Replayable campaign progression pad with evolving score thresholds and stars
Winner of the prestigious Spiel des Jahres 2023 award

dorfromantik_full_campaign.name: The Complete Countryside (All 5 Secret Boxes)
dorfromantik_full_campaign.description: The complete campaign arc, unlocking all 5 sealed achievement modules, special landscape tasks, and scoring cards.

dorfromantik_first_achievements.name: First Village Horizons (First 2 Secret Boxes)
dorfromantik_first_achievements.description: A light introductory campaign journey opening the first two secret boxes to introduce railway and special challenge tiles.

dorfromantik_master_high_score.name: Master Landscaper (Full Campaign & Target High Scores)
dorfromantik_master_high_score.description: An extensive campaign experience aiming to unlock every module and reach the pinnacle high-score tiers on the campaign achievement pad.

milestones.title: The First Flourishing Fields
milestones.description: Laying down initial riverways and matching forest borders to achieve the first regional campaign score threshold.

milestones.title: Tracks Across the Valley
milestones.description: Unlocking the first puzzle boxes, introducing rail junctions, special landscape tasks, and steam train networks.

milestones.title: River Confluences & Canals
milestones.description: Integrating harbour tiles and long water channels to unlock new achievement cards and scoring stars.

milestones.title: Wonders of the Realm
milestones.description: Constructing grand landmarks, windmills, and watchtowers that reward dedicated placement strategies.

milestones.title: The Master Harmonious Landscape
milestones.description: Opening the final secret achievement box and achieving the highest harmony score on the master campaign sheet.
